Bids for hiring of vehicles are being invited based on A + B + C model, where ‘A’ is monthly wage of the Driver as per Minimum Wages criteria of Central Govt/ State Govt (w hichever is higher) as per notified minimum wages circular on Dt 30/03/2026 plus statutory exp enses to be incurred on EPF, EDLI, Admin. Charges, ESI and bonus as illustrated at Annexure-1 which is Rs. 25,837.81/month incl GST@5%. ‘B’ is fixed monthly Vehicle rental Charges and ‘C’ is monthly Fuel Consumption Charges which is Rs.26,515/- considering diesel rate as Rs. 10 6.06/litre prevailing on Dt. Aug ‘2026 with tentative running of 3000 KM /Month and Fuel consu mption mileage as 12 KMs per litre Bidders are requested to quote total monthly charges for vehicle hiring considering driver char ges in skilled category (as per component A above), cost towards fixed monthly vehicle rental ( Component B) and cost towards fuel charges (as per component C above). A minimum floor price of Rs. 53,678.56/- (Incl Taxes) considering pre-specified cost of compon ents A and C as above has been kept. The differential between Bidder’s quoted price and the minimum floor price shall be towards component B i.e. fixed monthly vehicle rental charges (In cl Taxes). (a) Bidders are requested to quote the price in GeM portal itself. The Bid Prices quoted by the bidders cover all the Contractor’s obligations mentioned in or to be reasonably inferred from the Bidding Documents to successfully execute the intende d services, on a “Single Responsibility” basis. Bidders are required to quote the price for th e commercial, contractual, and technical obligations outlined in the Bidding Documents. Bidders shall not upload the price details in the technical part otherwise technical bid will b e rejected. (b) Bidders are required to quote total charges including GST. Where the Bidder does not charge GST under Forward Charge Mechanism (FCM) and GST i s applicable under Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM), the applicable GST under RCM shall be considered and added to the quoted price for bid evaluation purposes only. Further, the Financial Document indicating detailed price break-up shall be obtai ned from the bidder to ascertain the applicable GST structure and mechanism (F CM/RCM) for evaluation and compliance purposes. . 3.
